title: Who really killed Edward Kenway in Assassin's Creed
subject: edward
description:
Could Edward have seen Birch coming? 👇

The night Kenway Manor was attacked, and why Edward's son grew up a Templar. Spoilers for Assassin's Creed IV: Black Flag and the novel Assassin's Creed: Forsaken.

Fan-made content. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Ubisoft. Game images © their respective owners.

scenes.text: Edward Kenway survived the Caribbean, then died in his own London home.
Back in England he married Tessa Stephenson-Oakley, and their son Haytham was born in 1725.
His property manager, Reginald Birch, courted his daughter Jennifer, until she learned Birch was a Templar.
On 3 December 1735, a day before Haytham turned ten, masked men broke into Kenway Manor.
They took Jennifer. Edward fought them through the house and was run through, aged 42.
Birch had sent them for Edward's journal, then offered to raise the boy.
Haytham grew up a Templar, serving the order his father fought.
